Name: Bachelor Pet Alex
Author: blancium
Description:
Replaces the dark brown dog with a naked Alex. He cums and he pees. I tried to keep the vanilla sprite feel but idk how well that worked out.

If you're super attached to brown dog and want Alex to replace a different pet, just pop open the content.json file and change

        "Target": "Animals/dog4",

to

﻿"Target": "Animals/[insert animal of your choice here]",

Special thanks to [url=https://next.nexusmods.com/profile/Udunie/]@udunie[/url] for putting this brainworm in my head! Couldn't have gotten here without you!!

Update 1.1.0: cleaned up the sprites! Like, a lot.
[size=5]
NOT COMPATIBLE WITH PETS ENHANCED*
[/size]
The way Pets Enhanced is set up now, it prioritizes loading from its own assets.

*If you want to use this with Pets Enhanced like I had originally intended, please see below:

The spritesheet I created to work with it in the latest update is compatible, but you will need to go in and replace the spritesheet of the dog of your choice [i]in the Pets Enhanced mod folder
[/i]
Location: Pets Enhanced Mod > assets > Animals > Dog

Steps
1. Go to the above folder and find the spritesheet of the dog you want to replace
2. Rename the "alexdog" spritesheet in the assets folder of MY mod to the name of spritesheet of the dog you want to replace
3. Copy/paste the newly named alexdog spritesheet into the Pets Enhanced Mod/assets/Animals/Dog and choose to REPLACE the existing file
4. Goon
